period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2014 (Unaudited)"). Read visually from the original one-page landscape PDF layout (four panels: Consolidated Balance Sheet, Consolidated Cash Flow, Solo Profit and Loss Account, Cash Flow for the quarter on top row; Solo Balance Sheet, Consolidated P&L, Consolidated/Solo Statements of Changes in Equity below) since pdftotext's reading order interleaves the four panels. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2014' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the First Quarter ended 31 March 2014') figures are used, not the 'Consolidated' ones. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 131,199.67m + Total equity 18,385.06m = Total assets 149,584.73m. Cross-check: Solo equity as at 31-Mar-2014 (18,385,064,816) matches exactly the comparative figure shown in the FY2015 Q1 interim statement's Solo Statement of Changes in Equity. Income-statement figures are cumulative-from-Jan-1 (identical to a discrete quarter for Q1 specifically). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported); not a single reported line in this primary document. NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.
